title: Predicting the onset of period-doubling bifurcations via dominant eigenvalue extracted from autocorrelation
summary: Predicting the occurrence of transitions in the qualitative dynamics of many natural systems is crucial, yet it remains a challenging task. Generic early warning signals like variance and lag-1 autocorrelation identify critical slowing down near tipping points but lack practical thresholds for predicting imminent transitions.
